title: A view column on a field contributed by a disabled package fails the whole list (400 INVALID_FIELD) instead of dropping the column
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5

Found by the hotcrm lane's probe for hotcrm#2618 (report: hotcrm#2618 comment 6952320824, screenshot `issue-2618/expenses-psa-off.png` in the project files) on @objectstack 18.5.0. **Live on hotcrm main today.** Read in code on objectstack `main` fc5913e117.

## What happens

hotcrm's Project Delivery package contributes `crm_project` to `crm_expense` (an object extension; the expense package does not depend on it). The Expenses package's own list views name `crm_project` as a column. Disable Project Delivery: the extension field leaves `crm_expense`'s meta (correct), but the views keep the column, the console asks `select=…crm_project…`, and the server answers **400 `INVALID_FIELD` "Unknown field 'crm_project' on object 'crm_expense'"**. The grid shows "This view's query was rejected". Every Expenses list that shows the project column is unusable while Project Delivery is off. Same reading for a Project column added to Order to Cash's plan-step grid.

## Why, in code

`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-query-validation.ts` ~339–375: `resolveQueryFields` builds the known set from the object's current fields, and `assertQueryParamsAreFields` refuses any unknown name. Nothing between the view and the query drops a column whose field was contributed by a now-disabled package. Related but different cause: #34807 (draft-only field).

## Asked

A view column (and sort, filter, group) naming a field that a disabled package contributed is dropped where the view is served or where the console builds the query, not sent. Optionally lint can warn that a view names a field from a package its own package does not depend on.

## Done when

With the contributing package disabled, the list opens and shows its other columns; re-enabled, the column returns.
